name: AI Content Writer – Automatic Content Generator and Auto Poster
author: BeautifulPlugins

sections.description:
AI Content Writer – Automatic Content Generator and Auto Poster is a powerful AI tool that helps you generate high-quality content for your blog or website in minutes using advanced AI technologies like ChatGPT, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and more. With AI Content Writer, you can create engaging articles, blog posts, and other content in minutes, without the need for a professional writer. Simply enter a few keywords, and AI Content Writer will generate a unique, well-researched article that is ready to publish. AI Content Writer uses advanced natural language processing technology to create content that is both informative and engaging, making it the perfect tool for bloggers, content marketers, and website owners.

🚀 Upgrade to Pro | 📄 Plugin Documentation | 💻 Support

✨ Free Features

  • Full Auto-Blogging Pipeline: Campaigns automatically generate titles, write articles, fetch featured images, and publish posts on a schedule — hands-free from keyword to published post.
  • Powerful AI Models: Generate content with Google Gemini (free tier available) or ChatGPT (OpenAI), with live model lists and per-provider Test Connection buttons.
  • Structured, SEO-Complete Articles: Every article arrives with an SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, URL slug, excerpt, and suggested tags & categories — applied automatically.
  • Works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO & SEOPress: AI-generated SEO data is written straight into your SEO plugin — no copy-pasting. Sites without an SEO plugin get a built-in meta description fallback.
  • Block Editor AI Assistant: Generate or rewrite content directly inside the block editor with tone and length presets.
  • Classic Editor & WooCommerce Support: An “AI Writer” button on classic (TinyMCE) editors — including WooCommerce product description fields — with generate and rewrite-selection modes.
  • 23 Content Languages & 11 Writing Tones: Write in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Arabic, and 18 more languages, in tones from professional to humorous — per campaign or per generation.
  • Review Queue: Approve, regenerate, or delete generated posts before they go live — combined with draft-first publishing for full editorial control.
  • Bulk Title Import: Paste your own article titles into a campaign and let the AI write them all.
  • Author, Categories & Tags per Campaign: Every published post gets the author and taxonomy you configured — or AI-suggested categories and tags.
  • Featured Images from Pexels, Unsplash & Pixabay: Automatic image search per post with alt text and photographer attribution built in.
  • Campaign Dashboard & Logs: Progress bars, last/next-run times, per-campaign log filtering, and a statistics dashboard.
  • Duplicate Guard: Exact and normalized-slug title matching prevents the same article from being generated twice.
  • Secure by Default: API keys are stored masked, all output escaped, all input sanitized.

📊 Available Campaign Types

  • Articles: Generate articles on trending topics scraped from Bing.com and Bing.com/news.
  • RSS Feeds: Generate content from any RSS feed to keep your website updated with the latest news and articles.
  • Gemini: Keyword campaigns powered by the Google Gemini API — free tier available. (Freemium)
  • ChatGPT: Keyword campaigns powered by the OpenAI API. (Paid)
  • Claude, DeepSeek & OpenRouter: Additional keyword campaign types with AI Content Writer Pro.

🚀 Pro Features

Upgrade to AI Content Writer Pro for the complete automation suite:

  • Claude (Anthropic) AI Provider: Generate content with Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models. – Pro
  • DeepSeek AI Provider: A very cost-effective alternative with deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner. – Pro
  • OpenRouter Provider: One key for hundreds of models — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and more. – Pro
  • DALL·E AI Image Generation: A unique AI-generated featured image for every post instead of stock photos. – Pro
  • SEO Pack — FAQ Sections & Schema: Auto-generated FAQ sections with FAQPage structured data (rich-results eligible). – Pro
  • Internal Linking Automation: A “Related Articles” section linking posts that share categories or tags. – Pro
  • SEO Score Gate: Posts scoring below your quality threshold are held as drafts instead of auto-publishing. – Pro
  • Source Citations: Credit original sources with a nofollow link on scraped campaigns. – Pro
  • Drip Scheduling: Human-like randomized publishing gaps, a daily publishing window, and per-day caps. – Pro
  • Custom Prompt Templates: Replace the built-in prompt per campaign with your own, using {title}, {keywords}, {language}, and {tone} variables. – Pro
  • Publish Webhooks: Notify Zapier, Make, n8n, or any URL when a post goes live — auto-share to social media. – Pro
  • Faster Campaign Frequencies: Run campaigns every 5, 10, 15, or 30 minutes. – Pro
  • 999 Posts per Campaign: Raise the campaign target from 20 to 999. – Pro
  • Search & Replace + HTML Cleaner: Rewrite scraped content with find/replace pairs and strip unwanted elements by CSS selector. – Pro

Who Should Use AI Content Writer?

  • Bloggers who want to keep their blogs active with engaging content, quickly and easily.
  • Content Marketers who need to produce high-quality content for their websites and clients.
  • Website & Small Business Owners who want to attract more visitors by publishing regularly without hiring a professional writer.
  • Freelancers & Agencies who need to deliver content for clients without spending a lot of time and effort.
  • Affiliate Marketers who want SEO-friendly content that ranks well in search engines.

Get Started Today:

Install AI Content Writer – Automatic Content Generator and Auto Poster from the WordPress plugin repository and take control of your content creation process. With AI Content Writer, you can create high-quality content quickly and easily, without the need for a professional writer. Get started today and see the difference that AI Content Writer can make to your blog or website!

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services to provide its functionality. Below is a detailed explanation of the services used, the data sent, and links to their terms and policies:

Google Gemini API – FREE/PAID

  • Purpose: The Google Gemini API is used to generate content using AI technology.
  • Data Sent: The plugin sends the content to the Google Gemini API for processing. Text-based user input such as prompts or topics provided by the user. No personal or sensitive information is sent unless explicitly entered by the user in the content prompt.
  • When Data is Sent: Data is sent to the Google Gemini API when the user generates content using the plugin.
  • Terms of Service: Google Gemini API Terms of Service and Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
  • API Documentation: Google Gemini API Documentation

ChatGPT, OpenAI API – PAID

  • Purpose: The ChatGPT API is used to generate content using AI technology.
  • Data Sent: The plugin sends the content to the ChatGPT API for processing. Text-based user input such as prompts or topics provided by the user. No personal or sensitive information is sent unless explicitly entered by the user in the content prompt.
  • When Data is Sent: Data is sent to the ChatGPT API when the user generates content using the plugin.
  • API Documentation: ChatGPT API Documentation
  • Pricing: OpenAI API Pricing
  • Terms of Service: ChatGPT API Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: OpenAI Privacy Policy

Pexels API

  • Purpose: The Pexels API is used to search for and display free stock images for the generated content.
  • Data Sent: The plugin sends the search query to the Pexels API to retrieve free stock images related to the content. No personal or sensitive data is sent.
  • When Data is Sent: Data is sent to the Pexels API when the user searches for images for the generated content.
  • Terms of Service: Pexels API Terms of Service and Pexels Privacy Policy
  • API Doccumentation: Pexels API Documentation

Notes:

By using this plugin, users acknowledge that data is transmitted to the above services. We encourage users to review their terms and policies to ensure compliance with their data-handling practices. The plugin developers are not responsible for the data handling practices of the external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-content-writer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WordPress Admin Dashboard > AI Content Writer > Generate Content to start using the plugin and generate content using AI.
  4. Configure your API settings and start generating content.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free to use?

Yes, the plugin is free to use. However, you may need to purchase a subscription to use the AI content generation feature.

How do I get started with the plugin?

To get started, install the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository and configure your API settings. Once you have done that, you can start generating content using AI.

How do I configure my API settings?

To configure your API settings, navigate to WordPress Admin Dashboard > AI Content Writer > Settings and enter your API keys in the respective fields. You can get API keys from services like Google Gemini, ChatGPT, and others.

Is the Google Gemini API free to use?

Yes, the Google Gemini API has a free tier, so you can get started right away without a subscription. You may need to upgrade to a paid plan for higher usage limits. Other AI models like ChatGPT (OpenAI) require a paid API subscription.

How do I get API keys for the Google Gemini API?

To get API keys for the Google Gemini API, you need to sign up for a Google Cloud account and create a project. Once you have created a project, you can enable the Google Gemini API and generate API keys to use with the plugin.

Is the ChatGPT API free to use?

No, the ChatGPT API is a paid service. You need to purchase a subscription to use the ChatGPT API with the plugin. You can get API keys from OpenAI to use the ChatGPT API with the plugin.

How do I get API keys for the ChatGPT API?

To get API keys for the ChatGPT API, you need to sign up for an OpenAI account and create a project. Once you have created a project, you can generate API keys to use with the plugin.

Is the Pexels API free to use?

Yes, the Pexels API is free to use. You can get started with the Pexels API right away without any subscription.

How do I get API keys for the Pexels API?

To get API keys for the Pexels API, you need to sign up for a Pexels account and create a project. Once you have created a project, you can generate API keys to use with the plugin.

Can I generate content without an API key?

No, you need to configure your API settings to generate content using AI. You can get API keys from services like Google Gemini, ChatGPT, and others to use the plugin.

Can I generate content for any niche?

Yes, you can generate content for any niche using the plugin. The plugin supports a wide range of topics and can generate content on virtually any subject.

Does the plugin work with my SEO plugin?

Yes. When Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, or SEOPress is active, every generated post’s SEO title, meta description, and focus keyword are written directly into that plugin — no copy-pasting. Without an SEO plugin, the data is stored with the post and a basic meta description tag is output automatically.

Can I generate content in multiple languages?

Yes, you can generate content in multiple languages using the plugin. The plugin supports multiple languages, allowing you to create content in the language of your choice.

Can I customize the content generated by the plugin?

Yes, you can customize the content generated by the plugin to suit your needs. You can edit the content, add images, and make other changes as needed.

Is the content generated by the plugin unique?

Yes, the content generated by the plugin is unique and well-researched. The plugin uses advanced AI technology to create high-quality content that is ready to publish.

Can I use the plugin to generate content for commercial purposes?

Yes, you can use the plugin to generate content for commercial purposes. However, you may need to purchase a subscription to use the AI content generation feature.

Can I use the plugin on multiple websites?

Yes, you can use the plugin on multiple websites. However, you may need to purchase a subscription to use the AI content generation feature on each website.

Can I get support for the plugin?

Yes, you can get support for the plugin by visiting the plugin’s support page on the WordPress plugin repository. You can also contact the plugin developers for assistance with any issues or questions you may have.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater
  • MariaDB version 10 or later

2.4.1 (23 July 2026)

  • New: Classic editor support — an “AI Writer” button on classic (TinyMCE) editor screens, including WooCommerce product descriptions, with generate and rewrite-selection modes.
  • New: Structured AI responses — articles are generated as structured data (title, excerpt, SEO title/description, focus keyword, URL slug, and category/tag suggestions) and applied to posts automatically.
  • New: Review queue — Approve (publish now) or Regenerate individual campaign posts from the campaign edit screen before they go live.
  • New: Bulk title import — paste your own article titles into an AI campaign to queue them for content generation.
  • New: Choose Unsplash or Pixabay as the featured-image source alongside Pexels.
  • New: Filter the Logs page by campaign via the new “View logs” link on the Campaigns list.
  • New: Content language selection — AI campaigns and instant generation can now write in 23 languages.
  • New: Writing-tone presets (professional, conversational, friendly, and more) per campaign.
